title: Mug vanishes
instruction: Put the white lid on the top of the black mug
page_note: The manipulator covers the mug before it disappears, so the report has to separate occlusion from a real disappearance.

events.description: After being covered by the right manipulator, the mug with its lid disappears.
By the end of the clip, the relevant objects have disappeared from the scene, making it impossible to determine whether the task was completed.
